spec.scope: Skill cast, not attack-scoped; fires once regardless of weapon state.
spec.durationSemantics: Instant one-shot at battle start (frame 0); the cast's shield then follows Skill 2's own 5 sec duration.
spec.triggerIdentity: battleStart (once, t=0) — a FORCE-CAST of Skill 2, distinct from Skill 2's own cooldown timer. Per the force-cast convention, Skill 2's cadence first-fires t=0 because of THIS line, then repeats at CD.
spec.targetSet: Self (the cast); the cast's shield resolves to all allies per Skill 2's own clause.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Skill 2 modeled as a bare interval trigger first firing at t=CD (t=20s), dropping the t=0 force-cast — the classic no-'Activates when'-clause default applied without honoring this line.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: A shield event (from centi's skill2) targeting all 5 units is emitted at ~frame 0. RED under nearest-wrong: first shield event appears no earlier than ~frame 1200 (20s). Also assert no DOUBLE cast near t=0 (the force-cast must not stack with an independent t=0 interval fire).
spec.inertness: Moves no damage directly; only shield-event timing and tandem-trigger availability shift.

spec.scope: Full Charge attacks ONLY, and on LANDING (on-hit, not on trigger pull / not on cast). RL at chargeFrames 60 fully charges every auto shot, so in practice every landed shot procs — in and out of Full Burst (no FB gate in the text).
spec.durationSemantics: No duration stated — this is an instantaneous cooldown reduction applied per landing, NOT a persistent stat buff. Percent basis flagged ⚑: 9.16% of the 20s base CD = 1.832s per landing (percent-of-base is the literal reading; percent-of-remaining is the alternative to pin).
spec.triggerIdentity: Per-landed-full-charge (hitCount-per-shot semantics on a 1-hit RL; equivalently shot-landed), self-targeted, effect = tick the live Skill 2 timer down. NOT a passive.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Two near-misses: (a) a static passive 'Skill 2 CD ×0.9084' → fixed ~18.17s shield interval, ignoring fire cadence; (b) reading 9.16 as SECONDS via skillCooldownReductionSec 9.16 → ~10.84s interval. Faithful per-landing tick-down at her ~1.3–1.4s/shot cadence (60 charge frames + release latency, ⚑) compounds to shields roughly every 8–9s.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Measure consecutive skill2 shield-event gaps in the event log over 180s: faithful per-landing model gives gaps ≈ 8–9s (each landed full charge during the CD window shaves ~1.832s); RED under (a) gaps ≈ 18.2s and under (b) gaps ≈ 10.8s. Equivalently assert total shield casts in 180s sits in the faithful band, strictly above both misread bands. Secondary: the gap should LENGTHEN if her firing is suppressed (e.g. reload stretch), proving cadence-coupling.
spec.inertness: Centi's own damage totals must NOT move from this line (it is pure shield cadence); no damage event may carry it.

spec.scope: Heal to all allies, 9.7% of CASTER's final Max HP.
spec.triggerIdentity: Shield DESTROYED (broken by enemy damage) — NOT shield expiry. The sim models no shield HP pool and no incoming boss damage, so the destruction event is unreachable at scope; the line cannot fire.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Firing the heal on shield EXPIRY (every 5s lapse) — a phantom recovery event every shield cycle that would over-credit any on-recovery consumer teammate (Crown-style 'when recovery takes effect' kits) in tandem comps.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: NO heal/recovery events attributable to this line ever fire: with a patched teammate carrying a 'recovery'-triggered buff, that trigger receives ZERO activations sourced from centi (she has no other heal). RED under nearest-wrong: one recovery burst per shield cycle.
spec.inertness: Entire line inert at scope — no events, no damage, no tandem procs.

spec.kitLine: Shield 7% of user's final Max HP, 5 sec
spec.scope: Defensive shield — but tandem-live: it must EMIT shield events (the 'shielded' trigger / requiresShielded gate channel). The taxonomy forbids skipping shield lines as inert.
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec 5 — genuine wall-clock seconds (no round wording).
spec.triggerIdentity: Skill 2 has NO activation clause of its own: its cadence is owned externally — battle-start force-cast (S1 line 1) + the 20s CD shortened per-landing (S1 line 2). Do not author an additional independent interval that double-fires.
spec.targetSet: All allies INCLUDING self ('Affects all allies' — no except-self clause); shield magnitude keys off the CASTER's Max HP (caster-scaled, not per-target).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Skipped as 'defensive, no damage' with no shield effect emitted — silently killing every shield-synergy teammate's gate — or mis-targeted self-only.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Each cast emits a shield event to all 5 units with maxHpPct 7 (caster basis); a patched teammate with a 'shielded' trigger fires once per centi cast, and a requiresShielded-gated block is live during (and only during) the 5s windows. RED if zero shield events or self-only targeting.
spec.inertness: Adds no damage instance of its own; centi's own totals unchanged by the shield effect itself.

spec.kitLine: Deals 145.46% of final ATK as damage.
spec.scope: Instant burst-cast damage. 'Affects 5 enemy unit(s) with the lowest remaining HP' collapses to ONE instance against the single partless raid boss — the count clause selects targets, it does not multiply hits.
spec.durationSemantics: Instant, once per her own burst cast.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (HER OWN Burst II cast) — NOT fullBurstEnter and NOT stage-2 chain entry. Fires only on rotations centi actually wins the Burst II cast.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Emitting 5 damage instances against the lone boss (727.3% total), or letting the hit take the +50% Full Burst major (burst-cast damage lands BEFORE the FB window opens — verified project fact).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Exactly ONE burst-bucket damage event per centi burstCast, atkPct 145.46, with fbMajorApplied false and rangeApplied false on the event; total burst-bucket delta equals one instance per cast. RED under ×5 (five events / 5× delta) and under FB-credit (fbMajorApplied true).
spec.inertness: Zero burst-bucket events from this line on rotations where the OTHER Burst II unit (fixture: crown) takes the stage-2 cast.

spec.scope: Boss DEBUFF — a WHOLE-TEAM damage lever (every attacker's hits subtract less DEF for 10s), not a self buff and not defensive. The highest-risk skip in this kit.
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec 10 from her cast — wall-clock, correct as seconds.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (own Burst II). Order flag ⚑: whether her own 145.46% hit lands before or after the debuff applies on the same cast is prose-silent — pin the ordering in the test rather than assuming.
spec.targetSet: Enemy (boss) — expect a boss-held buffApply with casterIdx===null and targetIdx===null per the harness's boss-debuff convention.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Encoding as damageTakenPct 14.54 (a multiplicative ×1.1454 on final damage — wrong mechanic: DEF ▼ restores a FLAT DEF×0.1454 to the (ATK−DEF) term, identical absolute per-hit gain for small and large hits) — or dropping it entirely because the schema's defPct is documented self-inert.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: During the 10s post-cast window, a teammate's per-hit final damage rises by a constant FLAT amount ≈ 0.1454 × bossDEF per hit — the absolute delta is the SAME for a low-multiplier and a high-multiplier hit. RED under damageTakenPct: deltas scale proportionally (×1.1454) with hit size. Also assert the boss-held buffApply (stat+value filter, casterIdx null) exists for exactly ~10s and teammate damage outside the window is untouched.
spec.inertness: No effect outside the 10s windows; no effect on rotations she does not cast.

spec.scope: Self stat buff (her OWN Max HP).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Dropped as 'defensive, inert' (violates the keep-the-stat rule — a future HP-scaling consumer reads it), or granted to allies, or encoded as casterMaxHpPct semantics leaking to teammates. Note it ALSO slightly feeds her own kit: skill2's shield and the S1 heal key off her final Max HP.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: On her burst cast, a buffApply with stat 'maxHpFlat' (targetMaxHpPct resolves to flat HP) targeting ONLY centi, value = 5% of her Max HP, expiring ~10s later — AND total damage for all 5 units is IDENTICAL with this effect patched out (no HP→ATK scaler anywhere in the comp). RED if any teammate receives it or any damage total moves.
spec.inertness: All damage totals, all teammates — fully damage-inert in this kit; presence is asserted via the event log only.

loadBearingSet: skill2:7% caster-Max-HP shield to all allies, 5s
burst:145.46% ATK instant damage (single instance, no FB major)

skill1: ■ Activates when the shield created by Centi is destroyed. Affects all allies. Recovers 9.7% of the skill user's final Max HP as HP.

notes: Three shared-prior misreads I expect the driver to have risked: (1) DEFENSIVE-KIT SKIP — every line here except the burst nuke looks 'defensive'; the faithful model still has three damage-relevant levers: the shield's tandem 'shielded' events, the shield-destroyed heal's INERTNESS (must not fire on expiry), and the boss DEF ▼ team lift. A model where centi emits no events but her burst hit would pass a totals-only test and be wrong everywhere tandem matters. (2) CDR SEMANTICS — 'Cooldown of Skill 2 ▼ 9.16%' is a PERCENT applied per LANDED full charge; the two attractor misreads (static ×0.9084 stat; 9.16 read as seconds) give shield cadences of ~18.2s and ~10.8s vs the faithful cadence-coupled ~8–9s — assert the inter-cast gap, not just 'a shield exists'. The percent basis (of base 20s vs of remaining) is a genuine ⚑; whichever is chosen must be pinned explicitly in the test. (3) FIXTURE TRAP — centi is Burst II: controlComp(carry) seats the carry beside crown (also Burst II), so the two compete for every stage-2 cast under first-ready selection, and centi may cast on only a subset of rotations (or none). Every burst-line assertion must FIRST establish, from burstCast events, which rotations are hers, and the burst lines must be inert on crown's rotations. Do not key any burst effect to fullBurstEnter/stageEnter — that over-credits precisely because another B2 is present. Also reconcile: Skill 2's cadence is jointly owned by S1's two lines (force-cast t=0 + per-landing CDR on the 20s base CD) — authoring an extra independent interval alongside the force-cast double-casts at t≈0. Finally, the DEF ▼ needs the boss-DEF term of the damage formula (flat per-hit lift), NOT damageTakenPct — the flat-vs-proportional per-hit delta is the distinguishing observable.
